items.title: Joe Harris Interview, 1961-04-12
items.q: I named the whole rhythm section, the whole sax section, the whole band.

ctx.x: What did you not play a piano at the time?
Keto. Little Keto. I named everyone. I named the whole rhythm section, the whole sax section, the whole band.
Yeah, that's pretty good. I think you got that. Mm-hmm. And, uh, uh, you ever play any Olympia band? An all the band?
